readme: Declarative controlled-break map consumed by scripts/scenario-receipts.mjs.
One record per scenario id. The runner applies `edits` to `breakFile` inside an
ISOLATED COPY of the working tree, never in the shared tree, then emits the four
receipts scenario-state-resolve.sh derives RED_VERIFIED / IMPLEMENTED /
GREEN_TARGETED / REGRESSION_GREEN from.
Fields:
test               test identity, sourced from the manifest `linkedTests` and
verified against it at run time (a mismatch is refused).
breakFile          repo-relative file the break is applied to.
edits[]            {find, replace}; each `find` MUST occur exactly once or the
scenario is refused rather than guessed at. Either side may
be an array of lines, which is joined with newlines.
control            the negative control. RED and GREEN cite it byte-identically;
scenario-state-resolve.sh:406 refuses SCS-CONTROL-SUBSTITUTED
otherwise. The runner emits one string to both, so they cannot drift.
claim              the claim the receipt is evidence for.
implementationRefs production paths the scenario's behavior lives in.
vacuous            set true, with vacuousReason, when the behavior CANNOT be broken
in a way that fails its own test. That is a real finding about the
test, and it is recorded here rather than papered over with an
invented break.
An entry is only worth anything once the runner has actually executed it and
observed the red fail at its own assertion. An unverified entry is worse than an
absent one, because it looks like coverage.

SCN-008-001.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-001 valid local portfolio import creates one current revision
SCN-008-001.control: buildPortfolioRevision lineage removed: a committed revision records supersedes: null instead of the superseded portfolioId
SCN-008-001.claim: A confirmed import commits exactly one new current revision whose lineage names the revision it superseded

SCN-008-002.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-002 invalid or secret-bearing import is atomic and redacted
SCN-008-002.control: secret detection removed: secretFieldName and secretValue always return false, so a secret-bearing import raises no P008-IMPORT-SECRET
SCN-008-002.claim: A secret-bearing or invalid import is rejected atomically and its value is redacted rather than stored

SCN-008-003.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-003 explicit mandate alone supplies every hard constraint
SCN-008-003.control: MANDATE_NULLABLE_POLICY_FIELDS absent-detection removed so absent policy fields report 0 instead of 4
SCN-008-003.claim: Only the explicit mandate supplies hard constraints, and an absent policy field is reported absent rather than inferred

SCN-008-004.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-004 no mandate leaves goal fit and survival unavailable
SCN-008-004.control: projectRouteStates never-inferred fields seeded with 0.07 instead of null, so a missing mandate renders an inferred number
SCN-008-004.claim: With no mandate, goal fit and survival are reported unavailable rather than inferred from a default

SCN-008-005.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-005 TP-04-05 personal state coexists with the shared cache and the only published read is the constant privacy boundary
SCN-008-005.control: the published tool read declares personalDataIncluded: true, so the constant privacy boundary no longer asserts that nothing personal crossed into the shared cache
SCN-008-005.claim: Private portfolio state coexists with the shared public cache, and the only published read is the constant privacy boundary

SCN-008-011.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-011 clear behavior removes ranking influence and preserves portfolio
SCN-008-011.control: buildBehaviorClearCandidate no longer empties behaviorEvents, so a behavior clear leaves the ranking influence it claims to remove
SCN-008-011.claim: Clearing behavior removes behavior-derived ranking influence and preserves the portfolio

SCN-008-012.test: tests/portfolio-survival-foundation.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-012 behavior evidence excludes engagement and sensitive profiling
SCN-008-012.control: forbiddenBehaviorField always returns false, so engagement and sensitive-profiling fields are accepted into behavior evidence
SCN-008-012.claim: Behavior evidence excludes engagement metrics and sensitive profiling fields

SCN-008-013.test: tests/portfolio-survival-risk.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-013 arithmetic CAGR and conditional drag stay separate
SCN-008-013.control: compoundedCagr is assigned the arithmetic annualized value, so the CAGR row reproduces the arithmetic row instead of compounding the wealth index
SCN-008-013.claim: Arithmetic annualized return, compounded CAGR and observed volatility drag are rendered as three separate quantities and are never collapsed into one return

SCN-008-015.test: tests/portfolio-survival-risk.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-015 concentration lenses expose overlap and missing look through
SCN-008-015.control: a holding the lens cannot classify is bucketed as Other and counted as covered, so an unmeasurable lens renders as complete
SCN-008-015.claim: Concentration lenses expose overlap and missing look-through rather than folding unclassifiable holdings into a complete-looking distribution

SCN-008-016.test: tests/portfolio-survival-risk.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-016 beta alpha R squared and residual risk stay separate
SCN-008-016.control: beta is divided by the portfolio's own variance instead of the benchmark's, conflating the regression slope with an inverse-scaled correlation
SCN-008-016.claim: Beta, alpha, R squared and residual risk are computed and reported as separate quantities

SCN-008-017.test: tests/portfolio-survival-risk.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-008-017 marginal and total risk contributions reconcile
SCN-008-017.control: the weight factor is dropped from the Euler contribution, so the marginal contribution is reported as the total contribution and the sum no longer reconciles to portfolio risk
SCN-008-017.claim: Marginal and total risk contributions are distinct and reconcile to portfolio risk by Euler decomposition
